svg.title: G for Graphic Design: Print and Digital
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The original G becomes a painter's palette and pen nib with a pink ink drop, then graphic design outputs for print and digital appear. The original illustration is traced as vector paths.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; derived from 07_G_graphic_design.png; no external assets.
